patch: N2 seats - APPEND these entries to placements.json 'placements' and bump counts total/built by 6 (165 -> 171). Not applied yet: placements.json is loaded live.
why: Six NPC seat markers (kettle_bench, forge_bench, stable_bale, ness_bench, orrin_chair, camp_l1) stand on bare ground, so the N2A seat check makes NPCs stand there. Each entry puts a small seat mesh (top 0.42-0.46 m, under 4 m wide) on the marker.
coords: pos = tile - origin (81,76); y up; rotY radians; unrotated seat faces +z (south).

append.name: seat_forge_bench
append.note: forge_bench: in front of the forge, faces south

append.name: seat_stable_bale
append.note: stable_bale: by the small gate fire, faces it

append.name: seat_ness_bench
append.note: ness_bench: beside Ness cottage door, faces east

append.name: seat_orrin_chair
append.note: orrin_chair: against the lodge west wall, faces west (box within 0.25 m of marker 137.3,21.6)

append.name: seat_camp_l1
append.note: camp_l1: second log at the gate campfire, long axis tangent to the fire
